description:
Texture improvements for the “Myrmidon Pantheon” skin.
Added stronger highlights and richer, more saturated colors for the armor and weapons.
The character’s skin tone has also been adjusted so he no longer appears lifeless.
The original skin is required — this is not a replacement for the base model, but a modification of the in-game skin.
